security: Common Stock, par value $0.001 per share
footnote_text: On October 23, 2026, upon effectiveness of the Issuer's resale registration statement on Form S-3, all 65,001 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock held directly by Univest Securities LLC, together with accrued and unpaid dividends through October 15, 2026, automatically converted into 1,422,472 shares of the Issuer's common stock at a conversion price of $0.9129 per share. Univest Group, Inc. is the parent holding company of Univest Securities LLC and owns all of its outstanding equity interests. Yi (Edric) Guo is the Chief Executive Officer of Univest Securities LLC and owns approximately 49.7% of the outstanding Class A Common Stock of Univest Group, Inc. As a result of these relationships, Mr. Guo may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held directly by Univest Securities LLC. Mr. Guo disclaims beneficial ownership of such securities except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein, if any.
